name: Plexarchy
author: Plexarchy contributors
description: Plex music in the Omarchy bar: now playing, playback controls, and an attached library, search, playlist, and queue panel powered by mpv.

schema.label: Recent albums
schema.description: Number of recently added albums shown on the Home view.

schema.label: Library items per view
schema.description: Maximum artists, albums, playlists, or tracks loaded in one view.

schema.label: Bar playback controls
schema.description: Show previous, play/pause, and next buttons next to the track in the bar.

schema.label: Volume control
schema.description: Choose whether the player slider changes the Omarchy system output or Plexarchy's local mpv volume.

schema.label: Demo mode
schema.description: Show fictional music and never contact Plex or start mpv.
